scripts.dev:phaser: echo 'deprecated: use pnpm dev:react' >&2 && pnpm dev:react
scripts.build:phaser: echo 'deprecated: use pnpm build:react' >&2 && pnpm build:react
scripts.lint: eslint lib/src lib/scripts backend/web/src backend/web/scripts frontend/cli/src frontend/react/src
scripts.clean:logs: mkdir -p logs && find logs -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.gitkeep' -exec rm -rf {} + && echo 'cleared logs/'
scripts.clean:tmp: mkdir -p tmp && find tmp -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.gitkeep' -exec rm -rf {} + && echo 'cleared tmp/'
